ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across ~90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the lateral tips and central markings, creating a high-contrast ratio between the dark lobes and white surface anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. A pair of distinct vertical high-intensity curvilinear arcs is located on the left lobe, approximately 10% lateral to the median notch. Sparse, low-diameter high-intensity spots are scattered across the medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65-70 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The main trailing edge span exhibits low-amplitude serrations. High-frequency, high-amplitude pixel-boundary variations (jagged edges) are isolated at the extreme lateral 10% of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral margins, terminating in a convex upward curve at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with circular scarring/colonization at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (white on black) located on the left lobe near the median notch. One secondary diagonal linear abrasion visible on the medial right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent parallel vertical scars near the center-left; irregular, asymmetric jagged topography at the far right tip suggesting significant tissue loss or concentrated parasitic attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: The far right lobe tip exhibits a highly unique, bulbous geometric protrusion with dense white pixel mottling compared to the more tapered left tip.
